42201.a:
**Tekshiruv tartibi:**
```sh
docker inspect -f '{{.State.OOMKilled}} {{.State.ExitCode}}' api
docker stats --no-stream api
dmesg -T | grep -i -E 'oom|killed process'
```
- `OOMKilled=true` — container `--memory` limitiga urildi.
- `false` lekin 137 — kimdir `docker kill`/stop timeout (10s) dan keyin SIGKILL, yoki host OOM killer.

**Sabablar:** limit kichik, memory leak, runtime cgroup limitni bilmaydi (JVM eski versiya, Go `GOMEMLIMIT` yo'q), tmpfs/`/dev/shm` RAM yeydi.

**Fix:** avval o'lcha (`docker stats`, pprof/heap dump), keyin limit = peak + zaxira; Go'da `GOMEMLIMIT` ≈ limitning 80-90%.

**Gotcha:** limitni oshirish leak'ni davolamaydi — faqat o'lim vaqtini kechiktiradi.

42202.a:
**Debug:**
```sh
docker exec api cat /etc/resolv.conf
docker run --rm busybox nslookup google.com
docker run --rm --dns 10.0.0.2 busybox nslookup internal.corp
```
**Ko'p sabablar:**
- Host `nameserver 127.0.0.53` (systemd-resolved). Loopback container namespace'ida boshqa — Docker uni ko'chirmaydi, 8.8.8.8/8.8.4.4 qo'yadi. Korporativ firewall tashqi DNS'ni yopgan, ichki domen ham ko'rinmaydi.
- Firewall/`iptables` qayta yuklanib Docker NAT qoidalari o'chgan (container umuman internetga chiqmaydi).
- VPN DNS faqat host'ga qo'yilgan.

**Fix:** `/etc/docker/daemon.json`:
```json
{ "dns": ["10.0.0.2", "10.0.0.3"] }
```
keyin `systemctl restart docker`. User-defined network'da Docker embedded DNS (127.0.0.11) service nomlarini hal qiladi, tashqi so'rovni shu upstream'ga uzatadi.

42203.a:
**Belgi:** `ip route` da `172.17.0.0/16 dev docker0` va `172.18.0.0/16 dev br-xxxx` — ofis tarmog'i ham shu diapazonda. Kernel eng aniq (longest prefix) route'ni tanlaydi, paket docker bridge'ga tushadi.

**Fix** (`/etc/docker/daemon.json`):
```json
{
  "bip": "10.200.0.1/24",
  "default-address-pools": [{ "base": "10.201.0.0/16", "size": 24 }]
}
```
`systemctl restart docker`, eski user-defined network'larni qayta yarat (`docker network rm`; Compose: `down` + `up`).

**Oldini olish:** server image'ida (golden AMI, Ansible) shu config oldindan bo'lsin; tarmoq jamoasi bilan IP rejasi kelishilsin.

42204.a:
**Sabab:** container'lar `containerd-shim` ostida, lekin default'da dockerd to'xtaganda ularni ham to'xtatadi.

**Fix:**
```json
{ "live-restore": true }
```
`systemctl reload docker` (SIGHUP) yetarli. Endi daemon restart/upgrade paytida container ishlayveradi, daemon qaytgach qayta ulanadi.

**Cheklov:** major versiya upgrade'da ishlamasligi mumkin; Swarm mode bilan mos emas. Shuningdek `--restart unless-stopped` qo'y — reboot'dan keyin ham ko'tarilsin.

**Production yondashuv:** bitta host'ga bog'liq bo'lma — 2+ host + LB, host'larni navbat bilan yangilash (drain → upgrade → qaytarish).

42205.a:
**Nega:** layer'lar append-only. `COPY .env` layer'i image ichida saqlanadi; `rm` faqat whiteout yozadi.
```sh
docker history --no-trunc app:1.4
docker save app:1.4 | tar -x -C /tmp/img   # layer tar'larda .env bor
```
**Incident tartibi:**
1. Key'ni **darhol revoke/rotate** (image registry'da public/ko'p joyda pull qilingan bo'lishi mumkin).
2. Audit: key ishlatilganmi (provider log'i).
3. Image'ni registry'dan o'chir, qayta build.

**To'g'ri usul:**
```dockerfile
# syntax=docker/dockerfile:1
RUN --mount=type=secret,id=npmrc,target=/root/.npmrc npm ci
```
`docker build --secret id=npmrc,src=$HOME/.npmrc .` — layer'ga yozilmaydi. `.dockerignore` ga `.env`, CI'da trivy/gitleaks secret scan.

42206.a:
**Tekshiruv:**
```sh
docker exec api cat /sys/fs/cgroup/cpu.stat   # cgroup v2
# nr_periods, nr_throttled, throttled_usec
```
`nr_throttled` tez o'syapti — throttling.

**Mexanizm:** `--cpus=1` = har 100ms davrda 100ms CPU vaqti. App 8 thread bilan 12ms da kvotani yeb bo'ladi, qolgan 88ms kutadi. O'rtacha CPU past, lekin request kechikadi.

**Fix:**
- Go: `GOMAXPROCS` ni limitga moslash (Go 1.25+ avtomatik, eskida `automaxprocs`).
- JVM: container-aware versiya, thread pool kichraytir.
- Latency-sensitive servisda CPU limitni oshir yoki faqat request/reservation qoldir.

**Boshqa sabablar:** disk I/O (`iostat`), noisy neighbor, DNS lookup har request'da.

42207.a:
**Tartib:**
```sh
journalctl -u docker -u containerd --since -30m
df -h /var/lib/docker; df -i /var/lib/docker
du -sh /var/lib/docker/containers/*/*-json.log | sort -h | tail
cat /proc/sys/kernel/pid_max; ps -eLf | wc -l
```
**Ko'p sabablar:**
- `/var/lib/docker` 100% (log, dangling image, build cache) — daemon metadata yoza olmaydi.
- Inode tugagan (ko'p kichik fayl).
- PID/thread limit, `fork: Resource temporarily unavailable`.
- Zombie'lar yig'ilgan (`--init` yo'q).

**Mitigate:** eng katta json log'ni `truncate -s 0`, `docker image prune`, `docker builder prune`. Keyin log rotation (`log-opts max-size/max-file`), monitoring (disk 80% alert).

42208.a:
**Tekshiruv:**
```sh
systemctl is-enabled docker
docker inspect -f '{{.HostConfig.RestartPolicy.Name}}' proj-api-1
```
**Fix:**
```yaml
services:
  api:
    restart: unless-stopped
```
`systemctl enable docker`. `docker compose up -d` qayta (policy container yaratishda yoziladi).

**Gotcha:** `depends_on` reboot'dan keyingi tartibni kafolatlamaydi — daemon container'larni o'zi ko'taradi. App DB'ga retry bilan ulansin.

**Alternativa:** systemd unit `ExecStart=docker compose up` — qo'shimcha murakkablik, ko'pincha restart policy yetarli.

42209.a:
**Sabab:** Compose container'larni `com.docker.compose.project` label bilan kuzatadi. Service YAML'dan olib tashlansa, container avtomatik o'chmaydi.

```sh
docker ps --filter label=com.docker.compose.project=shop
docker compose up -d --remove-orphans
```
**Boshqa variant:** ikki papkada bir xil nom bilan loyiha (project name = papka nomi) — biri ikkinchisining container'larini "orphan" deb ko'radi. `name:` yoki `-p` bilan aniq nom ber.

**Ehtiyot:** `--remove-orphans` volume'ni o'chirmaydi, lekin ishlab turgan servisni to'xtatadi — prod'da avval ro'yxatni ko'r.

42210.a:
```yaml
services:
  db:
    image: postgres:16
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "pg_isready -U $$POSTGRES_USER -d $$POSTGRES_DB"]
      interval: 5s
      timeout: 3s
      retries: 10
      start_period: 10s
  api:
    depends_on:
      db:
        condition: service_healthy
    restart: unless-stopped
```
**Gotcha'lar:**
- `$$` — Compose interpolatsiyasidan qochish, aks holda host env'dan olinadi.
- Postgres init (birinchi start) da server qayta ishga tushadi — `pg_isready` vaqtincha "ok" deyishi mumkin; app retry baribir kerak.
- Migratsiya uchun alohida `migrate` service + `condition: service_completed_successfully`.

42211.a:
**Nega:** `up -d` o'zgargan service'ni recreate qiladi: eski to'xtaydi, keyin yangi start. App start + cache warm-up = downtime.

**Qisqartirish:**
1. `docker compose pull` alohida (image tayyor bo'lsin).
2. Graceful shutdown (`stop_grace_period`, SIGTERM handle).
3. Reverse proxy + 2 replica, birma-bir yangilash (`docker rollout` plugin yoki skript: scale 2 → yangi healthy → eski o'chir).
4. Blue/green: `api_blue`, `api_green`, nginx upstream'ni almashtirish + `nginx -s reload`.

**Qaror mezoni:** tez-tez deploy + SLA bo'lsa Compose chegarasiga yetding — Swarm (`update_config: order: start-first`) yoki K8s.

42212.a:
**Hozir:** volume o'chgan bo'lsa Docker'dan qaytmaydi. Backup'dan restore:
```sh
docker compose up -d db
gunzip -c backup.sql.gz | docker compose exec -T db psql -U app app
```
**Oldini olish:**
```yaml
volumes:
  pgdata:
    external: true      # down -v uni o'chirmaydi
```
`docker volume create pgdata` qo'lda.
- Avtomatik backup: kunlik `pg_dump` + offsite (S3), yoki pgBackRest/WAL-G (PITR).
- **Restore'ni muntazam sinab ko'r** — tekshirilmagan backup = backup yo'q.
- Prod'da Compose buyruqlarini skript/Makefile orqali, `-v` yo'q.
- Muhim DB uchun managed (RDS) ko'rib chiq.

42213.a:
```sh
docker service ps api --no-trunc --filter desired-state=shutdown
docker service inspect api --pretty | grep -A5 UpdateStatus
docker service logs api --tail 100
```
**Tipik xatolar:**
- `No such image` — registry auth: `docker stack deploy --with-registry-auth`.
- `insufficient resources` — `reservations` node'larga sig'maydi.
- `no suitable node` — placement constraint/label.
- Yangi task healthcheck'dan o'tmay o'ladi (`failure_action: pause`).

**Mitigate:** `docker service rollback api`.
**Oldini olish:**
```yaml
deploy:
  update_config: { parallelism: 1, delay: 10s, order: start-first, failure_action: rollback, monitor: 30s }
```

42214.a:
**Swarm portlari:**
| Port | Nima uchun |
|---|---|
| 2377/tcp | cluster management (manager'ga) |
| 7946/tcp+udp | node discovery / gossip |
| 4789/udp | VXLAN overlay data |
| IP proto 50 (ESP) | `--opt encrypted` overlay |

```sh
nc -zvu worker2 4789
docker node ls     # Ready/Active?
docker network inspect backend --verbose   # peers ro'yxati
```
**Boshqa sabab — MTU:** cloud/VPN'da MTU 1450 yoki kichik; VXLAN 50 bayt qo'shadi — kichik paket o'tadi, katta (TLS handshake) osilib qoladi. Overlay network'ni `--opt com.docker.network.driver.mtu=1400` bilan yarat.

**Gotcha:** 4789/udp ni internetga ochma — VXLAN autentifikatsiyasiz.

42215.a:
**Holat:** 3 dan quorum = 2. Bitta qolgan manager Raft yozuvini qila olmaydi: service yaratish/update ishlamaydi, lekin **ishlab turgan task'lar davom etadi** (data plane).

**Tiklash:**
1. Avval o'chgan manager'larni qaytarishga urin (ular qaytsa — quorum tiklanadi, eng xavfsiz).
2. Bo'lmasa, tirik manager'da:
```sh
docker swarm init --force-new-cluster --advertise-addr 10.0.0.11
docker node ls          # eski manager'lar Down
docker node demote m2 m3 && docker node rm m2 m3
docker swarm join-token manager   # yangi manager'lar qo'sh
```
**Oldini olish:** 3 yoki 5 manager, turli AZ'da; manager'larda og'ir workload yo'q (`availability: drain`); `/var/lib/docker/swarm` muntazam backup.

42216.a:
**Sabab:** `volumes: pgdata:` driver `local` — har node'da alohida. Scheduler task'ni boshqa node'ga ko'chirsa, u yerda yangi bo'sh volume. Postgres initdb qilib "toza" DB ochadi; app hech narsa topmaydi, yangi yozuvlar yangi volume'ga ketadi — **split data** xavfi.

**Mitigate:** yangi task'ni to'xtat (scale 0), eski node'ni tikla, ma'lumotni qaytar.

**To'g'ri yondashuv:**
```yaml
deploy:
  placement:
    constraints: [node.labels.db == true]
```
- Pin qilish = node o'lsa DB ham yo'q, lekin bo'sh DB ochilmaydi (xavfsizroq fail).
- HA kerak bo'lsa: Postgres replication (Patroni) yoki managed DB.
- Shared storage (NFS) ustida Postgres — fsync/locking xavfli, tavsiya etilmaydi.

42217.a:
```sh
docker swarm join-token --rotate worker
docker swarm join-token --rotate manager   # agar u ham tarqalgan bo'lsa
docker node ls     # notanish hostname/IP?
docker node rm --force <id>
```
**Nega muhim:** worker token bilan begona mashina klasterga qo'shilib, unga task'lar (va ularning **secret'lari**) tushishi mumkin. Manager token — butun klaster nazorati.

**Qo'shimcha:**
- Rotation mavjud node'larga ta'sir qilmaydi.
- Begona node bo'lgan bo'lsa: unga tushgan service'larning secret'larini rotate qil.
- Klaster CA rotate: `docker swarm ca --rotate`.
- 2377 portini faqat ichki tarmoqqa och; token'ni secret manager'da saqla.
